summary: 好教学需要可以练习的专业技能。文章分析现有师资培养和在职学习的不足，提出用课堂示范、反复练习和持续反馈改善教师表现。
logic: 从教师质量对成绩的影响切入
检验天赋说和速效改革
训练可观察的教学动作

paragraphs.brief: 教师的影响与天赋迷思
sentences: Forget smart uniforms and small classes.
先别谈整齐漂亮的校服和小班教学。
The secret to stellar grades and thriving students is teachers.
学生成绩出色、成长顺利，秘诀在于教师。
One US study found that in a single year’s teaching the top 10% of teachers impart three times as much learning to their pupils as the worst 10% do.
一项美国研究发现，一年之内，教学表现最好的 10% 的教师让学生学到的内容，是表现最差的 10% 的教师的三倍。
Another US study suggests that if black pupils were taught by the best quarter of teachers, the gap between their achievement and that of white pupils would disappear.
另一项美国研究表明，若黑人学生由表现最好的四分之一教师任教，他们与白人学生的成绩差距就会消失。
But efforts to ensure that every teacher can teach are hindered by the persistent myth that good teachers are born, not made.
但一个根深蒂固的误解妨碍了人们帮助每位教师掌握教学本领，那就是好教师生来如此、无法培养。
Government policies, which often start from the same assumption, seek to raise teaching standards by attracting high-flying graduates to join the profession and prodding bad teachers to leave.
政府也常从同一个假设出发，试图吸引出类拔萃的毕业生从教，同时促使表现不佳的教师离开，以此提高教学水平。
Teachers’ unions, meanwhile, insist that if only their members were free from centralised policies, excellence would follow.
同时，教师工会坚持认为，如果只有其成员能够摆脱集中管理的政策，那么优秀就会随之而来。
paragraphs.gist: 教师水平能显著影响学生一年里学到多少，但“好老师靠天赋”的看法让许多政策只重招聘和淘汰，忽略了培养教师的可能。

paragraphs.brief: 普通教师也可以通过训练进步
sentences: The premise that teaching ability is something you either have or don’t is mistaken.
认为一个人要么天生会教书、要么永远不会，这个前提是错的。
A new breed of teacher trainers is founding a rigorous science of pedagogy.
新一代的师资培训者正在建立严格的教学科学。
The aim is to make ordinary teachers great, just as sports coaches help athletes of all abilities to improve their personal best.
目标是把普通教师培养成优秀教师，就像教练帮助各个水平的运动员刷新个人最好成绩。
Done right, this will revolutionise schools and change lives.
如果做得好，这将彻底改变学校，也改变学生的人生。
paragraphs.gist: 新一代培训者把教学当作可训练的技能，希望像教练帮助各水平运动员突破个人最佳成绩一样，让普通教师也能成为优秀教师。

paragraphs.brief: 只靠招人换人的改革有局限
sentences: Education has a history of lurching from one ‘miracle’ solution to the next.
教育界一向容易在一个又一个号称“神奇”的解决办法之间摇摆。
The best of them even achieve some good.
他们中最优秀的人甚至能取得一些成就。
The US initiative Teach for America has brought energetic new graduates into the profession, and dismissing teachers for bad performance has boosted results in Washington, DC.
美国的“为美国而教”计划吸引了充满干劲的应届毕业生投身教育。在华盛顿特区，解聘表现不佳的教师也使学生成绩有所提高。
But each approach has its limits.
但每种办法都有其局限性。
Teaching is a mass profession: it cannot grab all the top graduates, year after year.
教学是大众职业：它不能年复一年地抓住所有优秀毕业生。
When poor teachers are fired, new ones are needed – and they will have come through the same educational system that failed to make fine teachers of their predecessors.
表现欠佳的教师被解聘后仍需要新人接替，而这些新人接受的，正是当初未能把前任培养成优秀教师的同一套教育。
paragraphs.gist: 招优秀毕业生或解聘表现差的教师虽可见效，却有规模限制，新人也往往出自没能培养好前任的同一套培训体系。

paragraphs.brief: 职前培训与课堂需要脱节
sentences: By contrast, the idea of improving the average teacher could revolutionise the entire profession.
相比之下，改进普通教师的想法可能会使整个职业发生革命性的变化。
Around the world, few newly qualified teachers are well enough prepared for the classroom.
在世界各地，很少有新合格的教师为教室做好充分准备。
A recent report found 31 countries in which more than a quarter of primary-school teachers had not reached minimal national standards.
最近一份报告发现，有31个国家超过四分之一的小学教师没有达到国家最低标准。
In rich countries, the problem is subtler.
在富裕国家，问题更为微妙。
Teachers qualify after completing a long, specialised course, which almost always involves superficial and seemingly useless discussions of theory.
教师要修完漫长的专业课程才能取得资格，其中几乎总要花时间讨论一些肤浅、看似也派不上用场的理论。
Some of these courses, including master’s degrees in education, have no effect on how well their graduates’ pupils end up being taught.
有些课程，包括某些教育学硕士课程，对毕业生后来能把自己的学生教得多好并没有影响。
paragraphs.gist: 许多国家的新教师尚未为课堂做好准备，即便在富裕国家，冗长的理论课程与部分教育硕士项目也未见改善学生实际获得的教学。

paragraphs.brief: 缺乏观课反馈使成长放缓
sentences: What teachers fail to learn in universities and teacher-training colleges they rarely pick up on the job.
教师在大学和师范院校没学到的东西，在工作中也很少有机会补上。
They become better teachers in their first few years as they get to grips with real pupils in real classrooms, but after that improvements tail off.
刚入行的头几年，教师在真实的课堂中慢慢学会应对学生，教得越来越好，但之后进步便放缓了。
This is largely because schools neglect their most important learners: teachers themselves.
这主要是因为学校忽视了最重要的学生：教师本身。

Across the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) club of mostly rich countries, two-fifths of teachers say they have never had a chance to learn by sitting in on another teacher’s lessons; nor have they been asked to give feedback on their peers.
在经济合作与发展组织(OECD)大部分是富国的俱乐部中，五分之二的教师说，他们从来没有机会通过坐到另一个教师的课上来学习；也没有要求他们向同行提供反馈。
paragraphs.gist: 教师入行头几年会因接触真实学生而进步，此后提升常放缓，因为学校很少让他们继续观课、交流或获得同伴反馈。

paragraphs.brief: 让全班持续参与的课堂方法
sentences: If this is to change, teachers need to learn how to impart knowledge and prepare young minds to receive and retain it.
如果要改变这种状况，教师必须学会如何传授知识，使年轻人准备好接受和保留知识。
Good teachers set clear goals, enforce high standards of behaviour and manage their lesson time wisely.
好教师会设定清楚的目标，对学生行为提出高要求并严格执行，还会合理安排课堂时间。

They use tried-and-tested instructional techniques to ensure that all brains are working all the time – for example, asking questions in the classroom with “cold calling*” rather than relying on the same eager pupils putting up their hands.
他们采用经实践验证的方法让每个人一直动脑，例如直接点名请学生回答，而不总是让那几个踊跃举手的学生发言。
paragraphs.gist: 有效教学需要明确目标、管理课堂时间，还可用随机点名等成熟方法保证全班都在思考，而非只让总举手的人参与。

paragraphs.brief: 用指导性课堂实践培养新人
sentences: Like other complex skills, teaching requires a route to mastery that is not based on abstruse theory but on intense, guided practice grounded in subject-matter knowledge and pedagogical methods.
和其他复杂技能一样，掌握教学靠的是以学科知识和教学方法为基础、在指导下密集练习，而不是艰涩的理论。
Trainees should spend more time in the classroom.
学员们应该在教室里多花点时间。
The places where pupils do best – for example, Finland, Singapore and Shanghai – put novice teachers through a demanding apprenticeship.
芬兰、新加坡和上海等学生表现出色的地方，都让新教师接受要求严格的学徒式训练。
In the US, high-performing schools teach trainees in the classroom and bring them on with coaching and feedback.
在美国，高水平的学校在课堂上教授受训人员，并给他们提供辅导和反馈。
paragraphs.gist: 教学像其他复杂技能，需要在学科知识和教学方法基础上接受指导、反复实践，芬兰、新加坡、上海等地都重视严格的课堂实习。

paragraphs.brief: 用毕业生表现检验培训课程
sentences: Teacher-training institutions need to be more rigorous.
教师培训机构需要更加严格。
A century ago, medical schools raised the calibre of doctors by introducing systematic curriculums and providing clinical experience.
一个世纪前，医学院通过采用系统的课程和提供临床经验，提高了医生的素质。
It is essential that teacher-training colleges start to collect and publish data on how their graduates perform in the classroom.
教师培训学院必须开始收集和公布有关其毕业生在课堂上表现的数据。
Courses that produce teachers who go on to do little to improve their pupils’ learning should not receive subsidies or see their graduates become teachers.
如果一门课程培养出的教师几乎不能改善学生的学习，这门课就不应得到补贴，毕业生也不应凭它取得任教资格。
They would then have to improve to survive.
这样一来，教师培训机构就必须改进办学才能生存。
paragraphs.gist: 师范院校应像医学院那样提高训练标准，公开毕业生的课堂表现，对不能培养有效教师的课程撤回补助和任教资格通道。

paragraphs.brief: 校内辅导与持续专业学习
sentences: Big changes are needed in schools, too, to ensure that teachers improve throughout their careers.
学校也需要大刀阔斧的改革，以确保教师在整个职业生涯中有所改进。
Teachers in the best ones hone their craft through observation and coaching.
在办得最好的学校里，教师通过观摩与指导磨炼教学本领。
They accept critical feedback, which their unions should not resist but welcome, as it is only proper for people doing such an important job.
他们愿意接受指出问题的反馈；从事如此重要的工作，接受反馈理所应当，教师工会也应欢迎这件事。

The best head teachers hold novices’ hands by helping them prepare high-quality lessons and arranging for more-experienced teachers to cover for them when they need time for further study and practice.
优秀校长会扶持新教师，帮他们备好课，需要进一步学习和练习时，还会安排更有经验的教师代课。
paragraphs.gist: 优秀学校用观课、指导与反馈支持教师长期成长，校长也帮新人备课，并在他们进修时安排资深同事代课。

paragraphs.brief: 以薪酬留住并调配优秀教师
sentences: Money is less important than one might think.
薪酬的重要性没有人们想象的那么大。
Teachers in top-of-the-class Finland, for example, earn about the OECD average.
例如，芬兰顶级教师的收入与经合组织的平均水平差不多。
But ensuring the best teachers stay in the classroom will, in most places, mean paying more.
但确保最好的老师留在教室在大多数情况下意味着支付更多。
People who thrive in front of pupils should not have to become managers to earn a pay rise.
擅长给学生上课的人，不应该非得转做管理才能获得加薪。
And more flexibility on salaries would make it much easier to attract the best teachers to the worst schools.
提高工资的灵活性将更容易吸引最好的教师到最差的学校。
paragraphs.gist: 薪水并非解释教育表现的唯一因素，但灵活加薪能让优秀教师留在一线，也更容易吸引他们到最需要帮助的学校。

paragraphs.brief: 专业声望与师资提升的循环
sentences: Improving the quality of the average teacher would raise the profession’s prestige, setting up a virtuous cycle in which more talented graduates clamoured to join.
提高普通教师的教学水平会提升整个职业的声望，进而吸引更多有才华的毕业生争相加入，形成良性循环。
But the biggest gains will come from preparing new teachers better, and upgrading the ones already in classrooms.
但最大的收益将来自为新教师做好更好的准备，以及提高已经在课堂上的教师的素质。
paragraphs.gist: 提高普通教师水平有助于提升职业声望、吸引人才形成良性循环，而最直接的收益仍来自改进职前培训并支持在职教师。

items.en: According to the third paragraph, why is dismissing bad teachers a poor solution to problems in educational standards?
items.zh: 根据第三段，为什么仅靠辞退教学表现不佳的教师难以解决教育水平方面的问题？
correct: Replacement teachers have the same training as the dismissed ones.
替代教师与被解雇教师接受同样的培训。

items.en: What does the writer say about teacher-training institutions in the fourth paragraph?
items.zh: 作者在第四段对教师培训机构有什么看法？
correct: Graduating teachers are not ready for the classroom.
刚取得资格的教师还没有为实际课堂教学做好准备。

items.en: In their first few years of working, teachers improve in the classroom because they
items.zh: 教师在工作的头几年里课堂上的进步是因为他们
correct: have to engage with the realities of the job.
必须面对并处理真实的课堂情况。

items.en: Which of the following does the writer suggest is least effective for teachers to use?
items.zh: 作者认为教师使用哪些方法最无效？
correct: responding to pupils who raise their hands to answer questions
回应举手回答问题的学生

items.en: The author suggests that head teachers can assist newly qualified teachers by
items.zh: 作者建议校长可以协助新合格的教师：

items.en: Of the many ‘miracle’ educational solutions that have been put forward, a few have been effective.
items.zh: 在提出的许多“奇迹”教育解决办法中，有一些是有效的。
items.why: 说明“诸多神奇方案中，少数确实有效”,与题干一致。

items.en: Understanding educational theories is an essential part of teacher training.
items.zh: 了解教育理论是教师培训的一个基本部分。
items.why: 作者认为单纯理论讨论“无用”,与“理论是必不可少” 相反。

items.en: Courses producing unsuccessful teachers should be given grants to improve.
items.zh: 应向培养出的教师表现不佳的培训课程拨款，帮助它们改进。
items.why: 作者主张停补贴，而不是“给经费改进”。

items.en: Education is currently underfunded, which is leading to problems in schools.
items.zh: 目前教育资金不足，这导致学校出现问题。
items.why: 作者认为资金的重要性低于人们的想象，重点放在师资培养。文章没有认定当前教育经费不足，也没有把学校问题归因于此。

items.en: Good classroom teachers should be paid more to remain in the classroom.
items.zh: 优秀的课堂教师应该得到更多的报酬才能留在课堂上。
items.why: 明确指出应提高薪酬以留住优秀教师。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: Just as any athlete can be coached for better performance,
items.zh: 正如任何运动员都能在教练指导下提高成绩……
items.answer: D · a teacher who is not outstanding can be improved.
items.solution: 表现普通的教师也能进步。

items.en: If teachers are to be taught the complex skills they require,
items.zh: 如果要教老师他们所需要的复杂技能
items.answer: A · practice will always be more important than theory.
items.solution: 实践总是比理论更重要。

items.en: In teaching, as in the medical profession,
items.zh: 在教学方面，如在医学专业,
items.answer: F · a better syllabus and more practical involvement will improve results.
items.solution: 更完善的课程和更多实践机会能改善培养效果。

items.en: If the status of teachers were improved,
items.zh: 如果教师的地位得到改善,
items.answer: C · more capable graduates could be attracted into the profession.
items.solution: 更有能力的毕业生可以被吸引到这个行业。

pairs: 题干用动词，定位句改用同词根的名词。
第 6 段 · 第 3 句
第 4 段 · 第 3 句
points: 作者认为资金的重要性低于人们的想象，重点放在师资培养。文章没有认定当前教育经费不足，也没有把学校问题归因于此。
题干问“如果教师的地位得到改善,”。定位句写到“提高普通教师的质量将提高该职业的威望，形成一种良性循环，让更有才能的毕业生大声疾呼加入”。
clauses: Another US study suggests that …, the gap between their achievement and that of white pupils would disappear.
连接词 if 引出“if black pupils were taught by the best quarter of teachers”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。
Government policies, …, seek to raise teaching standards by attracting high-flying graduates to join the profession and prodding bad teachers to leave.
“which often start from the same assumption”修饰前面的 policies。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 policies，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: What matters in schools is teaching.
学校里最要紧的是教学。
好在教书的本领也可以学会。
footnotes: *cold calling: a simple technique in which the teacher calls on specific pupils to answer a question, regardless of whether they have raised their hand
课堂点名提问：无论学生是否举手，教师都可以请特定学生回答问题。
